_about: Language pairs where DIRECT translation is trusted — the English-pivot 'Auto' mode
skips the pivot for pairs listed here. Any non-English pair NOT on this list is
translated source→English→target when pivot mode is Auto.
Codes are FLORES-200 keys matching language-codes.json. Pairs are SYMMETRIC:
one entry covers both directions (a→b and b→a).
RULE FOR ADDING ENTRIES: when in doubt, leave it out. A missing pair only costs
an unnecessary English hop (harmless). A wrong entry causes bad direct
translation — the exact failure this file exists to prevent (GLS 2026: cat→swe).
source: 'seed' = linguistic judgment, unmeasured. 'measured' = confirmed by a
benchmark A/B run — measured entries should also carry 'scoreDirect',
'scorePivot' (chrF vs FLORES references), 'engine' and 'measuredDate'.
ENGINE SCOPING: an entry may carry an optional 'engines' array (registry keys,
e.g. ["google", "nllb"]) limiting it to those engines; absent = all engines.
Seed entries are engine-agnostic (linguistic closeness doesn't depend on the
engine). Measured entries are per-engine by nature — a verdict for one engine
says nothing about another. The Auto decision order is: measured verdict for
(pair, engine) → cousins list → the engine's registry default bias.
Deliberate omissions (candidates for benchmark runs, NOT yet trusted):
nld↔afr (Dutch/Afrikaans — related but thinner direct data), cat↔glg,
ukr↔bel, nno↔swe/dan, ron↔ita/spa. Pivot handles them until measured.
